rebuild_note: The trapped group does not exist in the artwork. The crisis discovery is carried entirely by a caption.

what_it_communicates: NeonBlue freezes between stage and corridor
rebuild_note: The decision moment of the issue. Not in the script. Needs to be the strongest panel on the page.

what_it_communicates: Lil Devil applies force where NeonBlue marks
rebuild_note: The issue's only action beat. A static card row cannot deliver an impact.

what_it_communicates: Team clears the corridor; trapped group exits

what_it_communicates: Festival continues in reduced form
